name: pechmagnet
description: Pech-Magnet – Endless Runner (Capacitor-Wrapper für Android & iOS)

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync && npm run native
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.add:android: npm run build && cap add android && npm run native
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && cap add ios && npm run native
